list.name: service
list.label: Project
list.query: SELECT DISTINCT service FROM events WHERE type LIKE 'report.%' ORDER BY service;

panels.title: Открытых сейчас
panels.description: Текущее число открытых репортов (open_total из последнего события report.*). Точное — репорты меняют статус только через API, каждое событие несёт свежий тотал.

targets.rawSql: SELECT (payload->'scenario'->>'open_total')::int AS value FROM events WHERE service = '$service' AND type LIKE 'report.%' AND payload->'scenario' ? 'open_total' ORDER BY received_at DESC LIMIT 1;
SELECT (payload->'scenario'->>'closed_total')::int AS value FROM events WHERE service = '$service' AND type LIKE 'report.%' AND payload->'scenario' ? 'closed_total' ORDER BY received_at DESC LIMIT 1;
SELECT count(*)::int AS value FROM events WHERE service = '$service' AND type = 'report.created' AND received_at >= date_trunc('day', now());
SELECT count(*)::int AS value FROM events WHERE service = '$service' AND type = 'report.created' AND received_at > now() - interval '7 days';

panels.title: Закрыто за 7 дней
panels.description: Смен статуса на closed за 7 дней.

targets.rawSql: SELECT count(*)::int AS value FROM events WHERE service = '$service' AND type = 'report.status_changed' AND payload->'scenario'->>'status' = 'closed' AND received_at > now() - interval '7 days';

panels.title: Открыто / Закрыто во времени
panels.description: Тоталы open_total и closed_total как их нёс каждый event report.*. Ступенчато между событиями.

targets.rawSql: SELECT received_at AS time, (payload->'scenario'->>'open_total')::int AS "open", (payload->'scenario'->>'closed_total')::int AS "closed" FROM events WHERE service = '$service' AND type LIKE 'report.%' AND payload->'scenario' ? 'open_total' AND $__timeFilter(received_at) ORDER BY received_at;
SELECT date_trunc('day', received_at) AS time, count(*)::int AS "created" FROM events WHERE service = '$service' AND type = 'report.created' AND $__timeFilter(received_at) GROUP BY 1 ORDER BY 1;

panels.title: Лента событий репортов (новые сверху)
panels.description: Все события создания / смены статуса / удаления репортов. 'Новый репорт пришёл' = строка с типом report.created.

targets.rawSql: SELECT received_at AS "Время", type AS "Событие", payload->'scenario'->>'title' AS "Заголовок", payload->'scenario'->>'status' AS "Статус", (payload->'scenario'->>'open_total')::int AS "Открыто", (payload->'scenario'->>'closed_total')::int AS "Закрыто", payload->'scenario'->>'report_id' AS "Report ID" FROM events WHERE service = '$service' AND type LIKE 'report.%' AND $__timeFilter(received_at) ORDER BY received_at DESC LIMIT 200;
